editorial.blurb: A welcoming neighborhood coffee shop under the L tracks with exceptional espresso drinks, quality pastries, and a team that treats every customer like a regular.
editorial.insiderTip: Use the walk-up window for a quick order if you're in a rush, or grab a seat on the small outdoor patio (don't mind the train noise) if you want to linger with a single-origin pour and watch the baristas work their craft.
